message: border-radius isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android
hint: Round corners can be used in VML with the `RoundRect` element. See the [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/msdn-online-vml-roundrect-element).

message: Dark design without a dark-mode style
hint: Gmail on iOS and classic Outlook invert dark backgrounds to light. Test it, or add a prefers-color-scheme block.

message: border-radius: 50% needs a box with a px width and height; the corners stay square
hint: Use a px radius (50% of a square is half its side), or give the box a px width and height so the percentage can be resolved.
